هررتن (form I)
# هَرَرْتُنَّ (harartunna) /ha.rar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of هَرَّ (harra)
# هُرِرْتُنَّ (hurirtunna) /hu.rir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of هَرَّ (harra) and هُرَّ (hurra)
